name: Embrace Before Sunset
overview: After time-traveling into a fictional drama as a stand-in character, Song Wennuan agrees to a contract relationship with Zhou Shiyue, intending to leave after two years. However, as the contract ends, unexpected complications arise when he changes his mind. Meanwhile, the arrival of a mysterious man, Lu Ling, draws her into a web of hidden identities and destiny, reshaping her role in the story.
